audit_items.proof_trace: The two modifiers on invest() — whenNotPrefundAllocationPeriod (blocks prefundEndTime ≤ t < startTime) and whenSaleNotEnded (blocks t ≥ endTime) — together permit investment only during the prefund window (t < prefundEndTime) and the main sale window (startTime ≤ t < endTime), exactly matching the property. Timing fields are set once in initialize() via Solady Initializable and have no setters, so they are immutable after deployment.
